alerts.title: Viral load monitoring overdue on DTG-based regimen
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend checking viral load every 6 months for patients on two NRTIs plus DTG, reducing to 12-monthly only if VL < 50 copies/mL for over 1 year with reliable adherence. The patient's last viral load was 40 copies/mL on 2025-10-01, 113 days before this visit. The next viral load is due by approximately April 2026, so it is not yet overdue; however, no viral load was ordered today and the plan does not include scheduling the next test. Documenting the planned VL date ensures the 6-monthly schedule is maintained.

evidence.recommended_action: Schedule the next viral load for approximately April 2026 (6 months after the last result) and document the monitoring plan.

alerts.title: Renal function not monitored for over 15 months on TDF
alerts.message: The patient is on TDF, which is associated with renal toxicity, yet the most recent creatinine (88 umol/L) was measured 478 days before this visit. No renal function test has been done in over 15 months, and today's plan includes no creatinine order. Regular renal monitoring is important for patients on TDF-containing regimens to detect tenofovir-related nephrotoxicity early. The last value was normal, but its age means current renal status is unknown.

evidence.recommended_action: Order a creatinine/renal function test at this visit to update baseline before continuing TDF.

alerts.title: ADR screening not documented at this encounter
alerts.message: Guidelines state that at each encounter, all health workers should screen for suspected adverse drug reactions using the drug safety screening checklist, including neuropsychiatric symptoms such as insomnia, headaches, anxiety, and mood changes, which are relevant to DTG. The visit note records no new complaints and good adherence, but there is no documentation that a structured ADR screening checklist was completed. Completing and documenting the checklist ensures suspected ADRs, whether mild or severe, are recorded and reported.

evidence.recommended_action: Complete and document the drug safety screening checklist at this encounter, including neuropsychiatric symptom review.
